solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Two tables that one lays hands on

definitions.text: Two tables that one lays hands on

parts.words: Two tables that one lays hands on
parts.note: a key is a table of explanations and a board is a table, and together they make something whose surface the fingers rest on

explanation.surface: A riddle about some piece of furniture made of two tables on which a person rests their hands.
explanation.walkthrough: KEY (a legend, an explanatory table) joined to BOARD (a table, as in 'bed and board'); the whole clue describes the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A typist or pianist rests the fingers on the keys of this instrument or device.

clue.text: Clearly show 'Opening to Electric Cable'

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, so only the start of Electric is used

parts.note: Vince Cable, the Liberal Democrat Business Secretary when the puzzle appeared

explanation.surface: Looks like the title of an exhibit or a stage direction about electric cable.
explanation.walkthrough: Vince Cable was the UK's Business Secretary in 2015; his first name is needed, not the wire.
explanation.definitionFit: To evince a feeling is to reveal or display it plainly, a direct synonym.

clue.text: British love tossing up single pancake

indicators.note: in a down clue, tossing a word up turns it upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so NIL
a single one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: A British cook flipping one lone pancake with affection.
explanation.definitionFit: Blini are small Russian buckwheat pancakes, so this is one of them.

clue.text: What stylist might do with a new type of pasta

parts.note: a hair stylist might gel hair to set it

explanation.surface: Asks what a hairdresser does to a fresh kind of spaghetti.
explanation.walkthrough: The stylist's action is GEL HAIR; put A and N (new) before it.
explanation.definitionFit: Angel hair is a very fine, long variety of noodle, also called capellini.

clue.text: Passing entrance of cafe, see such a wine?

parts.note: passing away is death, a demise

indicators.note: the entrance of a word is its first letter, so only the start of cafe is used

explanation.surface: Someone walking past a café door and spotting a particular wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' is only a link here, pointing to the wine as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Demi-sec is a medium-dry style of champagne or other wine.

clue.text: Contractor finds one type of fungus in perimeter of buildings

indicators.note: the pieces are placed within the outline taken from buildings
the perimeter of a word is its outermost letters, first and last

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral
a cep is the porcini mushroom

explanation.surface: A building contractor discovers mushrooms growing around the edges of some houses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contractor' is not a builder but a muscle that contracts; I and CEP go inside B...S.
explanation.definitionFit: The biceps is a muscle in the upper arm that works by shortening to bend the elbow.

clue.text: Cleaning vessel for privates to remain back in regiment

parts.note: to bide is to stay or wait

indicators.note: the back of a word is its last letter, here the end of regiment

explanation.surface: Army privates told to stay behind in the regiment to scrub something out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'privates' are not soldiers but private parts.
explanation.definitionFit: A bidet is a low basin used for washing one's genitals and bottom.

clue.text: Stores dispatch guard

parts.note: a chain is a group of shops under one owner
to mail something is to send it off

explanation.surface: Shops send out a security guard.
explanation.definitionFit: Linked metal armour protected a knight's body, so it serves as a protective covering.

clue.text: Low life supporting short amphibian carrying little weight

parts.note: pro means in favour of

indicators.note: the shortened creature holds the weight within it
short means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a toad is an amphibian
oz is the abbreviation for ounce, a small weight

explanation.surface: A lowlife backing a stunted frog-like creature lugging a small load.
explanation.definitionFit: Single-celled organisms sit at the bottom of the scale of animal life, a humorous sense of lowlife.

clue.text: Greek character squeezes in pottery — it's done by a whisker?

indicators.note: the Greek letter pushes its way inside the pottery word

parts.note: Ming is fine Chinese porcelain
xi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek squeezes into a pottery shop, apparently by a hair's breadth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'whisker' is not a hair but a kitchen whisk, or one who whisks.
explanation.definitionFit: Beating batter together with a whisk is combining ingredients, the job such a utensil does.

clue.text: Press upset rubbish referee

parts.note: the press is the news media

indicators.note: upset means turned over, so the word for rubbish runs backwards

parts.note: rot means nonsense

explanation.surface: The press, annoyed, calls a match official's decision rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name someone neutral who settles a dispute between two parties.

clue.text: Coldness when sitting in seat troubled butt and leg? The latter, partly

indicators.note: the word for coldness sits inside the jumbled letters
troubled means stirred up, so the letters of seat are rearranged

parts.note: a chill is coldness
a butt is an end, as of a cigarette
in cricket the leg side is also called the on side

explanation.surface: A cold, troubled seat leaves someone's backside and leg aching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troubled' makes AEST from seat. 'leg' is the cricket on side. 'The latter, partly' says the answer is a part of the leg just mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: The tough cord joining calf muscle to heel is a component of the lower limb.

clue.text: See 11
Renaissance man's money, once billions, put in fancy casino

parts.note: the franc was French currency before the euro

indicators.note: the letter for billions is put inside the rearranged word
fancy as an adjective means elaborate or fanciful, so the letters of casino are reworked

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for billion

explanation.surface: An old-time gentleman's cash, worth billions, staked in a swanky gambling house.
explanation.definitionFit: The Elizabethan philosopher-statesman was a polymath of the late English Renaissance.

clue.text: Row on loch with fellow, finding open property

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the row word sits over the loch word

parts.note: a rank is a row, as of soldiers or taxis
Ness is the famous Scottish loch

explanation.surface: Rowing on a Scottish lake with a companion and finding some land open to the public.
explanation.definitionFit: Being candid is the quality of an open person, so 'property' means a characteristic.

clue.text: Storm's descent follows light rainfall

parts.note: to spit is to drizzle lightly
blood means lineage or ancestry

explanation.surface: A weather report: the storm comes down after a light shower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Storm' is a verb, to rage, not the weather the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: To be furious and rant is to be enraged, the idiomatic sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Shell-shock of soldier somewhere in Antipodes?

parts.note: TA, the Territorial Army, stands for a volunteer soldier
of here shows possession, written as an apostrophe-S
shell-shock is a soldier's frenzy, read here as mania

explanation.surface: Asks where a soldier's shell-shock might have struck, somewhere down under.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'shell-shock of soldier' as TA'S MANIA: a Territorial Army man's mania.
explanation.definitionFit: The island state lies south of mainland Australia, in the region Britons call the Antipodes.

clue.text: John returned to disrupt Tracy developing choice fabric

indicators.note: the toilet word breaks into the rearranged name
developing means changing form, so the letters of Tracy are rearranged
returned means sent back, so the toilet word reads backwards

parts.note: john is slang for a toilet, as is lav
will means choice, as in free will

explanation.surface: Someone named John comes back to upset Tracy, who is developing a taste for fine cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'John' is US slang for a toilet; 'returned' turns its synonym round, and 'to disrupt' puts that inside CARYT, the letters of Tracy 'developing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cavalry twill is a strong woven cloth with a diagonal rib, used for trousers.

clue.text: Weapon training event past peak

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill or peak
PE is physical education, training
a do is a party or social event

explanation.surface: A weapons-training event takes place beyond a mountain peak.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'past' sets PE and DO below TOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-propelled underwater missile is a naval armament.

clue.text: Heard Scotsman and German getting merry

indicators.note: heard means the word is taken as spoken rather than written

parts.note: Jock is a nickname for a Scotsman
und is German for and

explanation.surface: A Scot and a German are heard getting drunk together.
explanation.definitionFit: Jocund is a literary word for cheerful and light-hearted.

clue.text: Soul singer's Southern drummer attracts main birds

indicators.note: attracts means draws in, so the drummer takes the other pieces inside him

parts.note: Keith Moon was the drummer of The Who
key means main or principal
robins are birds

explanation.surface: A Southern drummer pulls in the main birds as a soul singer's backing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Motown star fronted The Miracles and sang 'Tears of a Clown', classic soul music.

clue.text: Strongly desire gain by Labour, after constituency's right wing ahead

indicators.note: the labour word comes after, with the wing letter placed ahead of it
the right wing of a word written left to right is its last letter

parts.note: to earn is to gain by working

explanation.surface: A political report: Labour gains a seat after the constituency's right wing moves ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right wing' is not politics but the end letter Y; 'after' and 'ahead' put it before EARN.
explanation.definitionFit: To yearn is to long for something intensely, a direct synonym.

clue.text: See 19
Outsiders coming in naturally like African native

indicators.note: the outsiders of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a la means in the manner of

explanation.surface: Outsiders arriving in an unforced way, like an African local.
explanation.walkthrough: 'native' is not a person but an animal native to Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The nyala is a spiral-horned antelope of southern Africa.

clue.text: Immature one in French contrived Grade E

parts.note: un is French for one

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A French pupil awarded a rigged grade E for being childish.
explanation.definitionFit: Being too young to be legally allowed something is not yet grown up.

clue.text: Left out of old memorial panel? It's hard to understand

indicators.note: out of means removed from, so the letter for left is taken away

parts.note: a plaque is a commemorative panel

explanation.surface: Someone left off an old memorial plaque finds its inscription baffling.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obscure, impossible to see through, is figuratively unclear.

clue.text: Dash to get hold of this jam producer

indicators.note: the expletive grips the other word inside it

parts.note: dash is a mild oath, like damn
so means thus, in this way

explanation.surface: Someone rushing to grab a jam-maker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dash' is the polite curse, not a rush.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit tree yields small plums used for preserves, so it produces jam.

clue.text: Warhorses on the way out getting measured in this?

parts.note: old means past its best, on the way out
horses' height is measured in hands

explanation.surface: Ageing war horses being measured for size.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Warhorses' means veterans, not horses, though the hands do measure horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Experienced veterans are figuratively warhorses.
